newsitem.title: POLAND: EBRD TO ENGAGE UP TO $20 MLN IN ROLIMPEX .
newsitem.headline: EBRD TO ENGAGE UP TO $20 MLN IN ROLIMPEX .

text.p: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) will engage up to $20 million in food processing projects by Polish food trader Rolimpex SA, the company said in a statement on Thursday.
The statement said the $20 million would reflect loans or equity investments in some of the firms in Rolimpex's holding.
It said the capital would help finance projects in grain processing and in the sugar, fodder and oil-and-fats sectors.
"The signing of the agreement affirms the EBRD's will to actively participate in the development and transformation of agricultural processing in Poland," the statement said.
